description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written during the late 19th century. This comprehensive work examines the tumultuous period in the Netherlands following the assassination of William the Silent, detailing the struggle for independence against Spanish rule leading up to the Twelve Years' Truce.
